name: TUI polish: startup MCP rows clear on first message; readable user rows
description: The '  ✓ mcp <name>: N tools' startup rows are removed from the transcript when the first message starts a task (start_task -> drop_mcp_ok); '  ✗ mcp' failure rows stay. The user's row is no longer drawn on a background band (the pale fill showed light text on near-white): the 'N›' marker keeps the theme's user colour and the text is bold, wrapped rows included.
evidence: cargo test: tui::app::tests::first_message_clears_mcp_startup_rows (✓ row gone, ✗ row kept, a live tool_line index shifts with its row); tui::render::tests::user_row_has_no_background_in_any_theme (every THEMES entry, marker and wrapped row: no faint, reverse or background SGR); status_markers_keep_their_colour_through_word_wrap updated to the bold form. ./init.sh passed.
decisions: First message is the trigger, no timer: once you have typed you know what loaded.

No band at all rather than a darker one: rusti cannot see the terminal's background, so any fill can clash; the terminal's own fg/bg pair is readable by definition, and bold keeps the row distinct from the answer.
Tints.user removed, since nothing draws it any more; the fail and ask bands are unchanged.
